about: A small underground area in the style of classic Zork-like dungeons. You start at the bottom of an endless stair, after a dream of a silver-haired mentor who calls this a final test. There is a junction with a sword in a rock, a barren area, shadowy hills, a cliff over an underground sea, and a lake with a view of a ruined aqueduct. A hooded figure in the Land of Shadow is a fight you win with the sword.

done.why: Nearly every other exit gave a 'not today' refusal: the east rockfall, the northwest slide, the beach gap, the squeeze, the misty wall climb and the quicksand. I had seen all the open rooms, so I stopped.

moments.note: Pulling the sword from the rock failed, but later it appeared in my hand on its own.
The hooded figure appears and the sword flies to my hand, glowing. A good scene.
Many exits are refused with 'not today', so the map feels thin.

wished: Get past the rockfall, the slide, the beach gap or the quicksand
Learn what the final test is or find the mentor
Read the runes on the sword

lines.line: It is the saddest thing you have seen underground, and you have seen some sad things.
The rock has the look of a thing that has been invited many times.

fun.why: Pleasant exploring and one good fight, but it is short and gated.

engagement.why: Interest dropped once most exits were blocked.

difficulty.why: The fight was easy and there were no puzzles I could solve. The blocked exits were not solvable.

interestingness.why: A familiar setting with some fresh touches, and a mystery left unanswered.

prose.why: The new room and exit text is wry and well made.
